_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: The overwhelming majority of cash generated by our assets is fee-based and is not sensitive to commodity prices. Risk factor: A sharp decline in the prices of oil, NGL or natural gas would result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from the production of oil, NGL, and natural gas and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value of our proved reserves.

classification.quality_note: The overwhelming majority of cash generated by our assets is fee-based and is not sensitive to commodity prices. Risk factor: A sharp decline in the prices of oil, NGL or natural gas would result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from the production of oil, NGL, and natural gas and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value of our proved reserves.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.25x; +0% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.02; conservative 2yr +41%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.6%/yr (worst year FY12-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -26.6%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.7-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY12-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2015-09-25) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.25x (42.2% downside to Bear $17 / +171.9% upside to Bull $80) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 2.17: gap -0.02 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +0% above the EPP floor $29 (33x FY15E $0.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: +40.8% total (+20.4%/yr) | At 33.1x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $39 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; segment EBDA -2.3% and Natural Gas Pipelines -2.8% in Q2 2015, forward revenues -12% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2015 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
